name: Tsugumi
source:
A host-obsessed adult woman, completely immersed working in the nightlife industry. A strong-willed woman who rejected [url=https://vndb.org/c139556]Karuta[/url]'s offer to take her away, and acts harshly even when her wish has been fulfilled. 

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/05/28/karuta/]official site[/url]]
